notes: BWS anchor raised (CAD, 22 Oct) from the corner-anchor height to bws_anchor z: at the old height the beam/cable would pass through the patient's chest. The BWS cable is vertical above the pelvis, so its force direction and the walker statics depend only on anchor x,y; all results are unchanged.

Front-centre anchor (centre_anchors[1], cable CF) is carried by the hinged front gate (front_gate block): a horizontal arm at pelvis height hinged on the front-right column, swung open outward for entry/exit and latched to the front-left column; the CF spool sits at the arm mid-span so that, with the gate latched, its cable exit is exactly this anchor and the analysis geometry is unchanged. The controller refuses to arm unless the latch sensor reports latched. No floor-standing post in the entry opening.

22 Oct round 3: belt (hd, hw) = the CAD value, needed for the mannequin; wheel contacts (wheels_x, wheels_y) are inset by wheel_radius from footprint_xy; each cable exit point equals its anchor coordinates exactly. belt_attach = nominal-pelvis ray-ellipse intersection (sizing.cable_dirs), BWS attaches at the pelvis point.
analysis (sizing.py, run_analysis.py, slip_analysis.py) and cad/build_cad_d3.py both read this file; analysis/i2_sizing/test_d3_consistency.py checks the generated CAD parts against it.

Passive slip thresholds (T_slip) re-tuned after the belt/anchor reconciliation (grid search over all motion directions); the earlier thresholds, tuned for the narrower SPEC belt, gave less than F_lim along the fall direction with the CAD belt. Derived fields (resultant_bound_all_slip, envelope_SF1p5, rated_hold_torque_Nm, lift caps, F_lim_wording) are regenerated by make_report.py through publish.py; do not type them.
F_lim_wording: passive slip brakes give >= F_lim (300 N) along the fall direction and <= resultant_bound_all_slip (380 N) horizontal resultant; the SF-1.5 static envelope is envelope_SF1p5 (420 N)

front_gate.open_direction: outward (+x): the arm swings about the vertical hinge axis from across the opening (+y) to pointing forward (+x)

interlock.rule: the controller refuses to arm (no nudge, no catch) unless the front-gate latch sensor reports latched; unlatching while armed drops to safe-stop

tube.orientation: 40 mm side horizontal (strong axis against the horizontal cable pull)
